Why Swift

Serious kit. Straightforward service.

Customer service first

We pick up the phone, quote fast and keep you posted. No call centres — you deal with the people who run the yard.

Family run, built on trust

A family business that treats every order — one downpipe or a full estate — with the same care.

Reliable supply

Backed by Freefoam & Freeflow — consistent stock, matched colours and systems designed to fit together first time.

Built to fit together

Freefoam & Freeflow — one matched system.

Freeflow guttering is designed to work hand-in-hand with Freefoam fascia and soffit — co-extruded white interiors, long-life seals and colour matched across the whole roofline.

Manufactured in the UK using recycled materials, with guarantees up to 50 years on registered white systems. Whether you're a developer, roofing contractor or a one-off replacement, it's the same reliable kit either way.
